unit.why: A single anecdote, reported by R. Pesach: on a cold winter journey the Besht sets a tree on fire with his finger to warm his companions, then rebukes R. Baruch for looking back at it.

stories.start_quote: עוד סיפר לי ר' פסח הנ"ל
stories.summary_en: While travelling home from Kaminka in bitter winter cold, the Besht touches a tree with his finger, sets it alight so his freezing companions can warm themselves, and afterwards rebukes R. Baruch of Kaminka for turning to look at what became of the tree.
